actions.reasoning: Red flags in this email: sender address (refunds@irs-tax-notifications.com) does not match official IRS domains; the prominent action link points to a non-IRS domain with an explicit port (http://irs-tax-refunds.com:8051/verify) and uses plain HTTP rather than HTTPS; urgent/pressure language to 'Verify Identity & Claim Refund' asking to confirm banking details is a common phishing pattern. The message may be crafted to impersonate the IRS (typosquatting and third-party domain). Because this indicates likely phishing or scam, do NOT submit any PII (SSN, bank routing/account, full card number/CVV, passwords, or other sensitive info) and do not follow the provided link.
